gates.reason: Inspected the auth-boundary regression: it verifies an authenticated admin warm-up cannot expose global shell data through unauthenticated GET /.
Server contract test; it does not produce detector recommendations, provenance claims, calculations, or validated fix snippets.
Test harness only; it does not ship a runtime hot path or new production surface.

Inspected GitHub-token handling, API URL construction, input validation, and label mutation; operational calls remain on api.github.com and no command, SQL, filesystem-write, or client injection sink is present.

Inspected release-config parsing and PR classification: labels are derived deterministically from linked-issue labels or explicit title prefixes, ambiguous inputs are not labeled, and results record the classification source.
Inspected batch API behavior: pagination is explicitly bounded, linked-issue reads are cached, and accumulated result size is bounded by the fetched pages.
Mocked unit tests do not handle real credentials, filesystem writes, browser content, commands, SQL, containers, or deployment configuration.
Tests cover the parser, deterministic classification precedence, ambiguity handling, merged-PR filtering, dry-run behavior, and failed linked-issue lookup behavior.
Unit-test code does not ship a runtime hot path or production surface.
Inspected path-probe sanitization: absolute, parent-traversing, home-relative, URI, remote, route, template, and Windows-style unsafe targets are masked or rejected before findings are admitted.

Inspected detector normalization: it validates report identity, schema, totals, severities, required checker cardinality, line provenance, artifact fields, stable IDs, and fails closed on incompatible reports.
The adapter uses bounded fixed-pattern passes and linear report traversal; no unbounded recomputation, network fan-out, or shipped interactive surface is introduced.
Tests exercise masking and rejection of path traversal, host-local paths, URIs, remote references, API routes, and locator forms without performing external probes.
Tests verify normalized provenance, semantic deduplication, severity conversion, false-positive suppression, schema rejection, and required-checker validation.
Unit-test fixtures do not ship a runtime hot path or production surface.
